title: Unable to delete an event when multiple events exist in a program
description: When a program contains more than one lighting event, the delete functionality for individual events does not work as expected, preventing their removal.
steps: 3. Enter 'Program D' as the program name.
12. Select 'No' for 'Do your lights have color control?'.
20. Select 'No' for 'Do your lights have color control?'.
24. Tap the trash can icon next to the 'When: Sunrise' event.
25. Observe the 'Unable to Delete' dialog stating 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'.
actual: A dialog box appears with the message 'Unable to Delete: Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists' when attempting to delete a lighting event, even though there are multiple events configured.
expected: When a program contains multiple lighting events, the delete functionality for individual events should work correctly, allowing the user to remove the selected event without error.
